data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 asserts that any execution result in a single-run record is post hoc rationalization and cannot constitute genuine verification, but its own countercondition admits that a deterministic sandbox gating the verdict mechanically, with text generated only after reading a contradicting output, yields counterfactual sensitivity. That admission is a counterexample to the categorical claim: if the engine's verdict is mechanically forced by an execution output it did not control, the run record contains exactly the distinguishing evidence (verdict flips on ground truth) the problem asks for, so single-run genuine verification is possible and the strict-necessity claim fails.
